name: The My Clips page in the TV layout, as admin in jellyfin-web's TV layout (localStorage.layout = 'tv'): the My Clips page over the probe's clips (bookmarks-clips-page-probe.mjs): the page body carries jfbm-page-tv, the toolbar fits on at most two lines at 1366 px, every control of it and every row's video link is a focusable element (a field, a select, a box or a link; the poster box is out of the focus order), and the keyboard moves through the toolbar with Tab. Run by bookmarks-clips-page-probe.mjs.

steps.name: My Clips with the probe's clips
TV: the page with jfbm-page-tv, the toolbar's controls on its lines, every control and video link focusable
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="clips"]'); const k = (id) => String(id || '').replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); const row = (id) => r && id ? r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-row[data-jfbm-clip="' + k(id) + '"]') : null; if (!((() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="clips"]'); const k = (id) => String(id || '').replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); const row = (id) => r && id ? r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-row[data-jfbm-clip="' + k(id) + '"]') : null; if (!r || r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-state') !== 'on') return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-content'); return !!c && !c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') && (!!c.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-row') || !!c.querySelector('.jfbm-notice')); })())) return false; const body = r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-page'); const t = r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-toolbar'); const controls = [...t.querySelectorAll('input, select')]; const tops = [...t.children].filter(c => c.getClientRects().length > 0).map(c => c.getBoundingClientRect().top).sort((a, b) => a - b); let lines = 0; let lineTop = -1e9; for (const top of tops) { if (top > lineTop + 20) { lines++; lineTop = top; } } const rows = [...r.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-clips-row')]; return { tv: body.classList.contains('jfbm-page-tv'), viewport: innerWidth, lines, controls: controls.map(c => [c.tagName, c.type || null, c.tabIndex]), rows: rows.length, links: rows.map(x => { const a = x.querySelector('.jfbm-clip-item-link'); return a ? a.tabIndex : null; }), thumbs: rows.map(x => x.querySelector('.jfbm-clip-thumb').getAttribute('tabindex')), header: (r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-bookmarks-link') || { tabIndex: null }).tabIndex }; })()

steps.name: as expected (every control a focusable element)
steps.assert: __vars.tv.tv && __vars.tv.viewport === 1366 && __vars.tv.lines <= 2 && JSON.stringify(__vars.tv.controls.map(c => c[0])) === JSON.stringify(['INPUT', 'SELECT', 'SELECT', 'SELECT', 'SELECT', 'INPUT']) && __vars.tv.controls.every(c => c[2] >= 0) && __vars.tv.rows >= 3 && __vars.tv.links.every(t => t === null || t >= 0) && __vars.tv.links.filter(t => t !== null).length >= 3 && __vars.tv.header >= 0
